title: Profile and grievance attachment cards on REST API
summary: Additive attachments[] on profile/grievance GET; multipart card upload on profile store and grievance store/update. Status-history and structure image APIs unchanged. No schema or backup/restore changes.

items: GET /api/profile/{id} includes attachments[] with serve URLs
POST /api/profile/store processes multipart attachment cards (same as update)
POST /api/grievance/store and update/{id} process attachment_title/description/file (+ attachment_section on replace)
